SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT IF(event_name = 'session_start', user_pseudo_id, NULL)) AS dau,
  COUNT(DISTINCT IF(event_name = 'card_rate', user_pseudo_id, NULL)) AS learners,
  COUNTIF(event_name = 'card_rate') AS ratings
FROM `japanese-vocabulary-490916.analytics_539684755.events_*`
WHERE (_TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE($__timeFrom(), 'Asia/Seoul')) AND FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE($__timeTo(), 'Asia/Seoul'))
    OR _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN CONCAT('intraday_', FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE($__timeFrom(), 'Asia/Seoul'))) AND CONCAT('intraday_', FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE($__timeTo(), 'Asia/Seoul'))))
  AND _TABLE_SUFFIX NOT IN (
    SELECT CONCAT('intraday_', SUBSTR(table_id, 8))
    FROM `japanese-vocabulary-490916.analytics_539684755.__TABLES__`
    WHERE table_id BETWEEN CONCAT('events_', FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE($__timeFrom(), 'Asia/Seoul'))) AND CONCAT('events_', FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE($__timeTo(), 'Asia/Seoul'))))
  AND event_date BETWEEN FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE($__timeFrom(), 'Asia/Seoul')) AND FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE($__timeTo(), 'Asia/Seoul'))
  AND app_info.id = 'dev.eastshine.kotonoha'
  AND COALESCE(user_id, '') <> '1'
  AND event_name IN ('session_start', 'card_rate')

  COUNTIF(event_name = 'card_rate' AND (SELECT COALESCE(value.int_value, CAST(value.double_value AS INT64)) FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'rating') = 1) AS r1,

  COUNTIF(event_name = 'card_rate' AND (SELECT COALESCE(value.int_value, CAST(value.double_value AS INT64)) FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'rating') = 3) AS r3,
  COUNTIF(event_name = 'card_rate' AND (SELECT COALESCE(value.int_value, CAST(value.double_value AS INT64)) FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'rating') = 4) AS r4
FROM `japanese-vocabulary-490916.analytics_539684755.events_*`

WITH ev AS (
  SELECT
    user_pseudo_id,
    user_id,
    event_name,
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date) AS d,
    (SELECT value.int_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'previous_first_open_count') AS prev_opens,
    device.mobile_model_name AS model,
    device.mobile_brand_name AS brand,
    app_info.install_source AS install_source
  FROM `japanese-vocabulary-490916.analytics_539684755.events_*`
  WHERE (_TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE($__timeFrom(), 'Asia/Seoul')) AND FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE($__timeTo(), 'Asia/Seoul'))
      OR _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN CONCAT('intraday_', FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE($__timeFrom(), 'Asia/Seoul'))) AND CONCAT('intraday_', FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE($__timeTo(), 'Asia/Seoul'))))
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX NOT IN (
      SELECT CONCAT('intraday_', SUBSTR(table_id, 8))
      FROM `japanese-vocabulary-490916.analytics_539684755.__TABLES__`
      WHERE table_id BETWEEN CONCAT('events_', FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE($__timeFrom(), 'Asia/Seoul'))) AND CONCAT('events_', FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE($__timeTo(), 'Asia/Seoul'))))
    AND event_date BETWEEN FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE($__timeFrom(), 'Asia/Seoul')) AND FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE($__timeTo(), 'Asia/Seoul'))
    AND app_info.id = 'dev.eastshine.kotonoha'
),
-- 운영자·스토어 테스트 기기는 설치 단위로 뺀다 (docs/analytics.md 해석 주의)
excluded AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM ev
  WHERE user_id IN ('1', '32')
    OR model = 'IN2025'
    OR (install_source = 'manual_install' AND brand IS NULL)
),
-- card_rate 는 2026-10-05 부터 남아서 그 전 설치는 복귀를 셀 수 없다
cohort AS (
  SELECT user_pseudo_id, MIN(d) AS installed
  FROM ev
  WHERE event_name = 'first_open'
    AND COALESCE(prev_opens, 0) = 0
    AND d >= DATE '2026-10-05'
    AND user_pseudo_id NOT IN (SELECT user_pseudo_id FROM excluded)
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
returned AS (
  SELECT
    user_pseudo_id,
    installed,
    LOGICAL_OR(s.d = DATE_ADD(installed, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS d1,
    LOGICAL_OR(s.d = DATE_ADD(installed, INTERVAL 2 DAY)) AS d2,
    LOGICAL_OR(s.d = DATE_ADD(installed, INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS d7
  FROM cohort
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id, d FROM ev WHERE event_name = 'card_rate') s USING (user_pseudo_id)
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id, installed
),
-- 오늘은 아직 안 끝나서 복귀 판정에서 뺀다
last_day AS (
  SELECT LEAST(DATE($__timeTo(), 'Asia/Seoul'), DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Seoul'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS t
)
SELECT
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(d1 AND installed <= DATE_SUB(t, INTERVAL 1 DAY)), COUNTIF(installed <= DATE_SUB(t, INTERVAL 1 DAY))) AS d1,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(d2 AND installed <= DATE_SUB(t, INTERVAL 2 DAY)), COUNTIF(installed <= DATE_SUB(t, INTERVAL 2 DAY))) AS d2,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(d7 AND installed <= DATE_SUB(t, INTERVAL 7 DAY)), COUNTIF(installed <= DATE_SUB(t, INTERVAL 7 DAY))) AS d7
FROM returned CROSS JOIN last_day

SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC(installed, ISOWEEK) AS cohort_week,
  COUNT(*) AS installs,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(d1 AND installed <= DATE_SUB(t, INTERVAL 1 DAY)), NULLIF(COUNTIF(installed <= DATE_SUB(t, INTERVAL 1 DAY)), 0)) AS d1,

  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(d7 AND installed <= DATE_SUB(t, INTERVAL 7 DAY)), NULLIF(COUNTIF(installed <= DATE_SUB(t, INTERVAL 7 DAY)), 0)) AS d7
FROM returned CROSS JOIN last_day
GROUP BY cohort_week
ORDER BY cohort_week DESC

-- 홈 카드 학습엔 체류 이벤트가 없어 카드 이벤트 간격을 더한다. 2분 넘게 비면 쉰 것으로 본다

  SELECT
    user_pseudo_id,
    event_date,
    mode,
    (event_timestamp - LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY user_pseudo_id ORDER BY event_timestamp)) / 1e6 AS gap
  FROM ev
  WHERE event_name IN ('card_reveal', 'card_rate')
    AND user_pseudo_id NOT IN (SELECT user_pseudo_id FROM excluded)
),
user_day AS (
  SELECT
    event_date,
    user_pseudo_id,
    SUM(IF(gap <= 120, gap, 0)) AS sec,
    SUM(IF(gap <= 120 AND mode = 'home', gap, 0)) AS home_sec,
    SUM(IF(gap <= 120 AND mode = 'source', gap, 0)) AS source_sec
  FROM study
  GROUP BY event_date, user_pseudo_id
)
SELECT
  TIMESTAMP(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date), 'Asia/Seoul') AS time,
  APPROX_QUANTILES(sec, 2)[OFFSET(1)] AS median_sec,
  AVG(sec) AS avg_sec,
  SUM(home_sec) AS home_sec,
  SUM(source_sec) AS source_sec
FROM user_day
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT bucket, COUNT(*) AS user_days
FROM (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN sec < 60 THEN '1분 미만'
      WHEN sec < 180 THEN '1–3분'
      WHEN sec < 300 THEN '3–5분'
      WHEN sec < 600 THEN '5–10분'
      WHEN sec < 1200 THEN '10–20분'
      ELSE '20분 이상'
    END AS bucket,
    CASE
      WHEN sec < 60 THEN 1
      WHEN sec < 180 THEN 2
      WHEN sec < 300 THEN 3
      WHEN sec < 600 THEN 4
      WHEN sec < 1200 THEN 5
      ELSE 6
    END AS ord
  FROM user_day
)
GROUP BY bucket, ord
ORDER BY ord
